verdict: PASS for the measured large-library UI latency improvement; no claim of universal no-regression or full acceptance.
scope: Three sequential baseline/candidate pairs, each with 20 warmups and 100 retained samples per stage. Nearest-rank p95 and p99 are computed separately per run. All paired percentiles and all greater-than-10-percent flags are retained below without a noise floor.
candidateTestFileCaveat: The benchmark records git status but does not hash the test script. The current test script hash is pinned above and was checked again after testing.

metadata.method: Playwright bundled full Chromium in a fresh ephemeral browser context; localhost HTTP owned by this process; all other HTTP requests aborted. Synthetic input and hashchange events exercise actual app handlers, input-to-frame ends at the next animation frame before paint. Native storage uses a real isolated-origin localStorage; library microbench uses a fake initial read and writer access, not the Web Locks app policy. UI uses real Web Locks. Warmups precede every stage.
metadata.cases: 0, 1, or 100 macros; every macro has 500 key events and maximum valid names/inputs; escaped case uses lone U+D800 code units.
metadata.limits: No hardware, companion, browser default profile, or production storage.

checks.copiedPairedVerifiers: All six exited 1 because they require a clean three-round baseline; baseline runs have one round and the candidates have intended uncommitted changes. Paired comparison performs the applicable checks.
checks.browserMacroSuite: PASS, 15 checks, isolated context, companion requests aborted, zero page errors
checks.staticCallerReview: Validity is read synchronously, before view construction. Inline edits synchronize after invalid state is updated. Successful event mutations render and unsuccessful mutations synchronize.

limits: The 100-escaped native storage and UI samples all include the expected quota-write failure; they are failure-path measurements.
Frame timing ends at the next animation frame before paint. Synthetic interactions use an isolated browser context and local server.
Recorded CPU, browser, power, battery, Node, and Playwright match across runs. Background load and other unrecorded system state were not controlled.

The script path determines its raw.json output location and the working directory determines the source root. Existing comparison hardcodes local paths and pinned hashes. A public harness needs portable paths and a safe non-overwriting output destination before use.

A greater-than-10-percent flag in an unchanged microbenchmark does not prove or disprove a code regression. Pair 2 of 100-escaped native library save rose from 76.6 to 87.7 ms p99, a 14.5 percent increase, while the three-run median p99 rose by 0.5 percent.

decision.acceptedScope: Measured large-library UI improvement from removing duplicate sync and per-refresh validation work.
decision.notAccepted: No universal no-regression, trusted-key/paint latency, companion benchmark, RSS/soak or full T05/T09 acceptance is claimed.
decision.flagsPreserved: All 69 comparisons retained; 14/35 unchanged micro and 4/34 small/empty UI combinations include at least one >10% pair flag.
decision.p95Goal: All measured large UI stages in the candidate are below the proposed 100 ms p95 on this reference machine.
